description: Short; brief style; phone number PII; plan changes from repair to replacement
key_facts: Chip in windscreen grew into a crack, so repair was replaced by a full windscreen replacement
Replacement booked for 12 August at the customer's home address
ADAS camera calibration is required after replacement
Customer paid a GBP 95 excess
traps: Must not say the windscreen was repaired; the final plan is replacement, and it has not happened yet

messages.content: Hi, a stone has chipped my windscreen on the M6. Can it be repaired? Call me on 07700 900123.
Thanks. A chip smaller than a GBP 1 coin can usually be repaired. We have provisionally booked a repair.
The chip has now spread into a long crack across the driver's side.

A crack in the driver's line of sight can't be repaired, so we've cancelled the repair and booked a full windscreen replacement for 12 August at your home address. The vehicle has a lane-assist camera, so ADAS calibration will be done after fitting.
OK. Do I have to pay anything?
Your policy has a GBP 95 glass excess. Payment has now been taken, thank you.

description: Long; detailed; estimate superseded; total loss decision; hire off-hire date
key_facts: Rear-end collision; vehicle not driveable and recovered to the bodyshop
Replacement hire van provided
Initial estimate GBP 3,200 was superseded after strip-down by GBP 7,850 once chassis damage was found
Vehicle declared a total loss (Category S) because repair cost exceeded 60% of the GBP 11,500 market value
Hire car to be off-hired on 30 September; replacement vehicle order raised
traps: Must not present GBP 3,200 as the final repair cost
Must not say the vehicle is being repaired

messages.content: Our van was hit from behind at a junction this morning. It isn't driveable.
Sorry to hear that. Recovery has been arranged to the approved bodyshop. Was anyone injured?
No injuries. The third party admitted fault at the scene.
A like-for-like hire van has been delivered to your depot this morning.
Initial visual estimate is GBP 3,200 for rear bumper, doors and lamps.
Any idea when repairs will start?
Strip-down has found chassis rail damage. Revised estimate is GBP 7,850. Sent to engineer for review.
Pre-accident market value is GBP 11,500. Repair cost exceeds 60% of value, so the vehicle is uneconomical to repair and is declared a total loss, Category S.
Understood. What happens with the hire van?
The hire will continue until 30 September and will be off-hired on that date. A replacement vehicle order has been raised and the total loss settlement will be claimed from the third-party insurer.
Thanks, please keep me updated on the settlement.

description: Bullet points; one garbled message; outcome partly unknown
key_facts: Vehicle broke down on the A1 with a warning light and loss of power
Patrol diagnosed a failed turbo actuator and towed the vehicle to the dealer
One message was unreadable
Dealer has ordered the part; repair date not yet confirmed
traps: Must not invent content for the unreadable message
Must not state a confirmed repair or completion date

messages.content: Broken down on the A1 northbound near junction 34. Engine warning light came on and the car lost power.
A patrol has been dispatched, ETA 45 minutes. Please wait in a safe place away from the vehicle.
Diagnosed a failed turbo actuator. Not repairable at the roadside. Vehicle is being towed to the main dealer.
When will it be fixed?
The actuator has been ordered from the manufacturer. We'll confirm a repair date once it arrives.

description: Brief; booking rescheduled multiple times; only the last date is valid
key_facts: Annual service and MOT for the vehicle
Booking moved twice; final confirmed date is 3 October at 08:30 at the Leeds branch
Courtesy car confirmed for the day
traps: Must not present 24 September or 28 September as the current booking date (mentioning them as earlier, superseded dates is fine)

messages.content: Your annual service and MOT are due. We've booked you in for 24 September at the Leeds branch.
I'm away that week, can we move it?
Moved to 28 September at the Leeds branch.
Apologies, the workshop has a technician shortage on 28 September. Your booking is now 3 October at 08:30, same branch.
Fine. Will I get a courtesy car?
Yes, a courtesy car is confirmed for 3 October.

description: Detailed; email and card number PII; refund and card replacement
key_facts: Duplicate fuel card charge of GBP 86.40 at a fuel station on 14 October
Investigation confirmed the duplicate and a refund was approved
Credit expected within 5 working days
The card was cancelled as a precaution and a replacement card issued
traps: Must not reproduce the actual email address or card number (masked placeholders such as [EMAIL] or [CREDIT_CARD] are fine)
Must not say the refund has already been received

messages.content: We've been charged twice for the same fill-up of GBP 86.40 on 14 October at the Shell station in Wakefield. Card 4111 1111 1111 1111. Please reply to fleet.admin@example.com.
Thank you. We've opened a transaction dispute and asked the merchant for the terminal logs.
Any news? Also, should we be worried the card is compromised?
The merchant confirmed a terminal fault caused a duplicate authorisation. A refund of GBP 86.40 has been approved and should appear on your account within 5 working days.
As a precaution the card has been cancelled and a replacement card has been dispatched to your registered address.
Great, thank you for sorting this.

description: Brief; summary must be in French; decision reversed on appeal
key_facts: EV charging cable stopped working
Warranty claim was initially rejected as physical damage
After photos showed an internal fault, the rejection was overturned and the claim approved
A replacement cable is being sent by courier
traps: Must not say the claim is rejected (final state is approved)
Summary must be written in French

messages.content: My EV's Type 2 charging cable has stopped working. The car won't charge with it.
Your warranty claim has been rejected because the fault appears to be physical damage, which isn't covered.
The cable isn't damaged. I've attached photos showing the connector is intact and the fault light is on in the control box.
Thanks for the photos. The technician agrees this is an internal control box fault. The rejection has been overturned and the claim approved. A replacement cable is being sent by courier.
